name: VA HOME ADMIN — NOVA POSHTA & DISCOVERY FLOW
changes: Connects manual Admin 2.0 orders to the existing live Nova Poshta location lookup for city and branch/parcel-locker search
Stores Nova Poshta city, settlement and warehouse refs in manual orders while preserving an explicit manual fallback
Fixes Discovery Set — 6 in manual orders: the sixth scent auto-confirms the set, collapses the long picker and shows a compact 6/6 summary with Edit selection
Adds dedicated regression checks for Nova Poshta manual-order lookup and Discovery completion
notes: No new Supabase migration or Edge Function deployment is required: the existing nova-poshta-locations function is reused.
create-order, Monobank, checkout and public storefront payment flows are not modified by this release.
Nova Poshta manual fallback remains available only as an explicit choice when the lookup cannot match a location.
